description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, summarizes, and analyzes meetings and calls. It helps teams turn conversations into searchable notes, insights, action items, and workflow automations.
summary: Fireflies.ai exposes a GraphQL API at `https://api.fireflies.ai/graphql`, a WebSocket-based Realtime API at `wss://api.fireflies.ai`, and an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://api.fireflies.ai/mcp`; developer access is primarily via a Fireflies API key, with MCP also supporting Fireflies account OAuth.
